_comment: Measured defects used as NEGATIVE CONTROLS. House convention: a negative
control that stops reproducing is itself a finding, so a leg that expects a
defect and does not find it reports BROKEN telling you to delete the entry,
rather than quietly turning green. Every entry must have been MEASURED on the
date it records; nothing here may be predicted.
NOTHING HAS BEEN MEASURED FOR THIS SUBJECT, so this file declares no group at
all, and that is deliberate. subject.mjs requires the file to EXIST; only
etc/go/lib/known-defects.mjs reads its groups, and only p7-wizard calls it --
a leg this subject does not declare, because it has no wizard module. An
empty-but-present group would be a claim that a leg's controls are vacuous;
no group at all is the honest statement that no leg here consumes one. If a
group is ever needed, known-defects.mjs refuses with 'no group <name>', which
names the gap instead of hiding it.
DO NOT CONFUSE THIS FILE WITH THE FIXTURE'S DEFECTS. The source text carries
20 recorded drafting defects (D1-D20 in the foundation phase's
runs/source-defects.md, summarised in NOTES.md). Those are defects in the
INSTRUMENT, found by reading it; this file is for defects in the PIPELINE'S
PROJECTIONS of it, found by running them. They are different kinds of thing
and the drafting defects do not belong here -- recording them here would make
a leg assert that a badly drafted policy keeps being badly drafted, which no
leg measures and no run could falsify.
See etc/go/subjects/regcf/known-defects.json for the entry shape and for the
convention that an empty group states its reason.
